about.title: About me
paragraphs: I have been passionate about event technology for more than 10 years, with experience in almost every area of the industry. Whether sound, light, stage or video: I offer full-service support for your event, from a single source.

I mainly support corporate events, galas, trade shows and conferences, from the first idea through to the final execution. I also support bands professionally at concerts, on tour or for single shows, including technical planning, setup, sound check and live support.
Planning a company party, a cultural event, or need support for a live production? Just get in touch, and together we will make your event an experience.

rubik.name: Rubik
paragraphs: We cover music our own way. Sometimes unplugged, sometimes flat out. We play (almost) everything you know, from Queen, the Beatles, Sting and Stevie Wonder to more special, less familiar songs by Florence and the Machine or Alicia Keys. If you don't find something you like here, that's on you!

With our own interpretations and ideas we give the classic cover songs a whole new coat of paint, colourful, different and unexpected. We scramble the finished Rubik's cube again, every time. Come by, dance along, have fun!

bademeister.name: Die Bademeister
bademeister.photoAlt: Profile picture of the band Bademeister
paragraphs: We are a cover band made up of current and former students of FH Aachen. We got our start at the first summer festival of the Electrical Engineering and Information Technology department (2022). What was meant as a one-off show quickly grew into something more: we rehearse regularly and have played, among other things, the joint Christmas market of the AStA student councils at FH Aachen.
Musically we offer a varied mix of international and German rock and pop songs, from classics like Zombie by the Cranberries to tracks by Måneskin, Kraftklub and Alligatoah.

fourfold.name: Fourfold
paragraphs: Founded for "Jugend jazzt", the young band Fourfold from the Mönchengladbach area has played regular small and medium-sized shows for about 4 years. Whether in converted churches, music cafés or jazz cellars, the band plays wherever handmade funk, soul and fusion music is in demand.

Thanks to its unusual line-up (vocals/trombone, vocals/trumpet, guitar, drums, bass), the five-piece band creates a colourful mix, from instrumental jazz standards and fusion classics to modern funk and jazz in the style of Nils Landgren, Jamie Cullum or the Heavytones. The band presents its songs, covers and originals, always arranged in house, with a fresh sound and the energy it takes.

singingLittleBigBand.name: Singing Little BigBand of FH Aachen
paragraphs: The Singing Little BigBand is, like the Full House Big Band and the Jazz Combo, one of the jazz ensembles of FH Aachen. Its programme is vocal: it combines singing with a big band and plays well-known songs in exciting arrangements. It gives live concerts at university events.

bigBand.name: BigBand of FH Aachen
paragraphs: Since 2007 the Full House Big Band of FH Aachen has performed at internal and public events under the direction of Boris Bansbach. Students, alumni and friends of FH Aachen play in it together and rehearse weekly. The Jazz Combo of FH Aachen is its "little brother".

jazzCombo.name: Jazz Combo of FH Aachen
paragraphs: As the "little brother" of the Big Band, the Jazz Combo of FH Aachen performs at internal and public events, also under the direction of Boris Bansbach. It was formed after the Full House Big Band and, like it, is one of the jazz ensembles of FH Aachen.

herrenjedeck.name: Herrenjedeck
paragraphs: Herrenjedeck play Cologne's carnival classics in Kölsch, the local dialect, dialect and all, since that is the whole point. Their tagline, "Kölsche Tön met Jeschmack" ("Cologne tunes with taste"), sums up a band from Jülich playing the best of Kölsch music with real heart, from singalong songs to rocked-up versions of Cologne classics.

As they put it themselves: "Herrenjedeck, dat es Hejmat, Jesellichkejt un Stimmung. Dat jilt för et Jedränk jenau esu wie för uns Kapell." ("Herrenjedeck is home, togetherness and atmosphere, true of the drinks just as much as of our band.") Catch them at Carnival, at festivals, at corporate events and at private parties.
